scope: Production gap repairs and honest remaining work

gaps.remaining: Fresh deployed issuance and independent-wallet verification remain required.

gaps.area: Shared wallet resets and concurrent cleanup
gaps.resolution: Rust run sessions separate cookie capabilities, storage and run IDs; close drains active operation leases. Shared browser adapters use the owned session before mutation, including D01/D04 callers of the common receipt helper.
gaps.remaining: Local isolation does not establish a public wallet product or deployed security qualification.

gaps.resolution: Lifecycle references an exact existing active organization profile and cancels only captured pending transactions through the shared authenticated API/readback helper.
gaps.remaining: Lost creation IDs, an issued-record race or unconfirmed readback retain incomplete cleanup.

gaps.resolution: Lifecycle recorder configuration now enables the live IPC required by its actual driver, pins the reviewed source and retains its acknowledged fixture JSON in both modes.
gaps.remaining: Set DEMO_D06_DRIVER_REVISION to the exact reviewed checkout; the source/config regression does not execute beta or create release media.

gaps.area: D03 minimal age disclosure and trust rejection
gaps.resolution: Dedicated native age-receipt validator, recorder adapter and exact Flow-result UI expose authenticated mdoc element names and refuse extra disclosure or generic rejection as trust evidence.
gaps.remaining: Pinned EUDI and Spruce native runs remain mandatory; an issuer-specific negative observation is required and typed backend reason stays unknown.

gaps.area: D05 foreign issuer and naturally expired offers
gaps.resolution: Local shared support driver checks real native signature/trust/Auth results, natural short server TTL, no session on denial, and successful trusted reissue/login.
gaps.remaining: Preprovisioned governed fixtures, a real deployed signing path and an isolated 60/120-second TTL lane are required.

gaps.area: D05 native consent, expiry and evidence controls
gaps.resolution: Shared source-grounded flow uses actual Add to Wallet, Approve and Cancel controls; provisions each clean lane, checks real mobile sign-out, separates wallet IDs and verifies same-browser results. Expiry waits before native handoff and reads authoritative application state.
gaps.remaining: No new native recording. Native-intent fallback must be supported by the pinned Chrome profile; unsupported chooser profiles remain blocked.

gaps.area: D09 loopback collector and premature native queue ACK
gaps.resolution: Rust Organization commits authenticated immutable receipts in PostgreSQL; native reporting retains queue IDs until exact durable receipt validation; recorder requires deployed readback and duplicate replay.
gaps.remaining: Changed gateway, Organization migration/service and native verifier must be deployed together. A receipt is a client-report submission, not physical-device attestation.

gaps.area: D10 placeholder signer and configuration-only success
gaps.resolution: Explicit real HTTPS OpenBao inputs and fresh challenges for VC issuer and OID4VP purposes are validated through shared Rust marty-crypto.
gaps.remaining: Signing capability is distinct from actual issuance/presentation, and the live external KMS path remains NOT_RUN.

gaps.resolution: Strict public projection preserves lane identity and exact evidence file hash; recorder and current UI/Python consumers enforce the schema, and UI labels separate wallet lanes.
gaps.remaining: The full report is hash-checked, not a cryptographic attestation.

gaps.resolution: Only unpublished scenario revisions and descriptions align with current executable contracts; all numbered assertion declarations reconcile.
gaps.remaining: Declaration coverage gives no runtime PASS and no historical media is promoted.

gaps.remaining: Fresh capture required; no independent-wallet, TTL, or public wallet product qualification is inferred.
